shoes.title: OOPBUY Shoes Spreadsheet: 3 Finds, Sizing & QC
shoes.description: Compare three OOPBUY shoe finds with matching product links, USD reference prices, seller sizing checks, warehouse QC and shoe-box shipping considerations.
takeaways: Match product IDs and the selected seller option.
Compare foot or insole measurements using the same method.
Budget shipping with explicit shoe-box instructions.

hoodies.title: OOPBUY Hoodies Spreadsheet: 3 Finds & Fit Checks
hoodies.description: Compare three OOPBUY hoodie listings, USD reference prices, chest and sleeve measurements, set options and warehouse QC before choosing a size.
takeaways: Confirm whether the listing is a hoodie or a set.
Compare chest width, body length and sleeve measurements.
Separate fabric claims from what photographs can verify.

jackets.title: OOPBUY Jackets Spreadsheet: 3 Finds, Fit & Shipping
jackets.description: Compare three OOPBUY jacket finds with matching links, USD price references, layering measurements, QC checks and packed-size shipping guidance.
takeaways: Match the exact option and leave room for intended layers.

Compare final parcel dimensions before choosing freight.

fees.title: OOPBUY Fees: Calculate Your Total Haul Cost
fees.description: Build an OOPBUY haul budget covering products, domestic freight, optional services, payment costs and international shipping, with a worked USD example.
takeaways: Keep product, service and shipping charges separate.
Distinguish estimates, confirmed charges and paid amounts.
Use the worked USD budget without treating it as a live quote.
